QuaternionRandom.Euler: Roll X / Pitch Y / Yaw Z (degrees)
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionIdentity: No rotation: FloatX4 XYZW = (0,0,0,1). Use Break Vector4 to read individual X/Y/Z/W pins.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionCompose: Construct raw FloatX4 XYZW from four scalars, without normalization. W defaults to 1; zero is not a valid rotation.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionNormaliz: Normalize XYZW robustly; a zero quaternion fails instead of becoming identity.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionConjugat: Return (-X,-Y,-Z,W), without normalization. This equals inverse only for unit quaternions.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionInverse: Return conjugate(q)/length(q)^2, including non-unit inputs. Zero fails.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionMultiply: Hamilton product A*B: apply B first, then A. No automatic normalization or vector rotation.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionFromEule: Degrees, matching LIBERA matrices: Rz(Yaw)*Ry(-Pitch)*Rx(-Roll). Produces XYZW, not Euler vector components.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionToEuler: Normalize XYZW and return matrix-compatible Roll/Pitch/Yaw degrees. At gimbal lock Roll is zero; zero quaternion fails.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionAxisAngl: Normalize Axis and rotate right-handed by Angle in degrees. Zero axis fails, even for zero angle. Euler X/Y use the opposite angle sign.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionSlerp: Normalize both endpoints and use the shortest rotation arc. Clamp T to 0..1; handle q/-q and nearly identical endpoints. Zero endpoints fail.
QuaternionRandom.Help.QuaternionRotateVe: Explicitly rotate a vector by normalized XYZW, without translation or scale. Zero quaternion fails.
QuaternionRandom.Help.RandomFloat: Stateless Seed/SampleIndex sampling between Min and Max; reversed bounds swap. Both identifiers must be integers 0..4294967295, carried on Float pins.
QuaternionRandom.Help.RandomInt: Integer-valued Float in inclusive Min..Max; reversed bounds swap. Bounds must be signed 32-bit integers. Rejection removes modulo mapping bias. Use Float To Int32 explicitly.
QuaternionRandom.Help.RandomVector3: Stateless XYZ box sampling with distinct component streams. Reversed Min/Max components swap independently. Seed/SampleIndex are unsigned 32-bit integer-valued Floats.
QuaternionRandom.Help.RandomUnitSphere: Stateless direction on the unit sphere, using equal-area Z/azimuth sampling. Seed/SampleIndex are unsigned 32-bit integer-valued Floats.
QuaternionRandom.Help.RandomInSphere: Stateless point in the unit ball with volume-weighted cube-root radius. Seed/SampleIndex are unsigned 32-bit integer-valued Floats.
